root_cause_criterion.obligation: The caller-owned `pmatch` buffer must be fully initialized before `regexec` when `nmatch > 0`, so every `regmatch_t` field later consumed on the success path is defined.
root_cause_criterion.fix_mechanism: The fixed wrapper zero-fills `pmatch` with `memset(pmatch, 0, nmatch * sizeof(*pmatch))` immediately before calling `regexec`.

nodes.description: On the `rc == 0` path, `magiccheck` reuses the same caller-owned `pmatch` storage returned from `file_regexec` when it rewrites `ms->search` from `pmatch.rm_so` and `pmatch.rm_eo`.
Immediately before the `mprint` call at the sanitizer sink, `match` still carries the regex-derived `ms->search.rm_len` value produced in the earlier success-path update.

edges.description: The same caller-owned `pmatch` buffer that `file_regexec` passes to libc regex is the stack object `magiccheck` later reads on the `rc == 0` path.
The `ms->search.rm_len` value materialized from regex match state in `magiccheck` is the same length state still present at the later `match` sink just before `mprint` executes.
